card_roubao.png:
A grey tabby cat ninja, cartoon illustration for a card game, landscape composition.
Same character as the reference image: light grey tabby fur with dark grey stripes, white chest and paws,
narrow half-lidded eyes, a NAVY BLUE ninja headband with two trailing tails, a dark navy ninja outfit with a dark belt,
long tail with dark rings.
Subject: throwing a rapid flurry of two soft paw punches, both front paws blurred forward
The subject fills about 80% of the frame, centred. Dynamic and readable at thumbnail size: bold silhouette,
strong pose, no fine detail that disappears when shrunk.
Nothing else in the picture: no ground, no shadow, no text, no letters, no watermark.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying.
Output 1024x768 PNG. Save the image as card_roubao.png in the current directory and report the path.
